# Forgepoint Capital

Forgepoint Capital is a Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals company. Forgepoint Capital is a global early-stage venture capital firm that backs transformative cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and infrastructure software companies, from first call to exit. Forgepoint Capital employs 75 people (+2.7% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2015. Headquartered in San Mateo, California, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Spain, United Kingdom, Canada, and Sweden).

## About

Forgepoint Capital is a leading venture capital firm that invests in transformative cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and infrastructure software companies protecting the digital future. With $1B+ AUM, the largest sector-focused investment team, and portfolio of more than 40 companies, the firm brings over 100 years of proven company-building experience and its Global Advisory Council of more than 100 leaders to support entrepreneurs advancing innovation globally. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area and London, Forgepoint is proud to help category-defining companies reach their market potential and to cultivate a diverse community dedicated to backing builders of the digital future. 

For more information about Forgepoint and our family of companies, visit forgepointcap.com. For all other inquiries, including investment, career, and partnership opportunities, please contact info@forgepointcap.com. Generic and automated emails will not be viewed favorably.

Forgepoint Capital is a leading venture capital firm that invests in transformative cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and infrastructure software companies protecting the digital future. With $1B+ AUM, the largest sector-focused investment team, and portfolio of more than 40 companies, the firm brings over 100 years of proven company-building experience and its Global Advisory Council of more than 100 leaders to support entrepreneurs advancing innovation globally. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area and London, Forgepoint is proud to help category-defining companies reach their market potential and to cultivate a diverse community dedicated to backing builders of the digital future. 

For more information about Forgepoint and our family of companies, visit forgepointcap.com. For all other inquiries, including investment, career, and partnership opportunities, please contact info@forgepointcap.com. Generic and automated emails will not be viewed favorably.
